verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile's own marketing explicitly promotes reviewing pull requests, merging code, and even Copilot-assisted code review 'right from your phone' (github-mobile-docs-1, docs-4, docs-15, docs-18), but hands-on community reports describe the review experience as functionally hampered—wrapped diff lines from oversized code font, unusable per-commit review, and missing PR-review-assignment notifications on Android (github-mobile-comm-4, comm-8)—directly contradicting the smooth 'review PRs on the go' claim. Missing for 10: independent recent (post-Copilot-era) hands-on reviews confirming these issues are fixed, and iOS-specific review-quality corroboration beyond older 2019-2020 threads.
